prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1310; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Conroe. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, I'm fine to continue.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was pulling out of a parking space near the front entrance of the shopping center. I had just put my car in reverse and was checking my mirrors.

Q: What did you see before the impact?

A: I didn't see much at first. I think a vehicle was coming down the main drive toward the exit, but I was focused on backing out. I felt the impact on the rear passenger side before I really registered the other car.

Q: How fast were you moving when it happened?

A: Very slowly, maybe walking speed. I don't think I'd been moving more than a few seconds.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: My head hit the side window. I didn't pass out, but I was dizzy and had a headache right after.

Q: Have you sought medical care since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same afternoon. They said I have a concussion and told me to limit screen time and rest for a while. I still get headaches and some light sensitivity.

Q: Did you give any statement to the other driver or the police at the scene?

A: I told the officer what I remembered, that I was backing out and felt the impact. I was pretty shaken, so I may not have gotten every detail right.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add or correct?

A: Only that I want to make sure my medical bills and time off work are documented. I'm still recovering, so I'd appreciate follow-up on that.

Q: Thank you. We'll be in touch with next steps and any documents we need from you.

A: Thank you.
